checkpoint_finding.warning: The exact code revision postdates all three GEO releases. It has no learned weights, but parameter and code choices must be frozen now and cannot be revised after sealed outcomes are opened.

interpretation: ABC is a strong task-native unsigned enhancer-gene baseline. Its contamination surface is not checkpoint pretraining; it is data-derived peak calling, activity normalization, contact choice, gene/TSS authority, neighborhood denominators, and threshold selection. With GSE289173 lacking ATAC, only a precommitted development-built static link atlas can be queried at the seal. That can support retrieval or a composite but cannot by itself predict signed cell-type eQTL/ieQTL effects.
known_incidents_and_biases: The upstream variant-overlap helper hard-codes 0.015 and 0.1 score filters, a 2-Mb distance filter, region shrinking, and shell execution; it is prohibited.
The upstream self-promoter rule forces scores to one and can dominate promoter-overlapping variants.
ABC scores are relative within each gene-TSS neighborhood, so changing the candidate peak or TSS roster changes every denominator.
The upstream K562 quantile reference and thresholds are not calibrated to donor-by-cell-state liver ATAC or a GENCODE v49 gene roster.
A distance power law is not observed cell-specific 3D contact. A MegaMap sensitivity is a reference contact prior, not donor-specific liver Hi-C.
remaining_blockers: Pass a CPU SLURM fixture for the exact source and environment, including candidate regions, qnorm, power-law scoring, deterministic continuous outputs, coordinate overlap, and no network access.
Activate GSE296875 only after donor/barcode/well, fragment, reference, peak, QC, missingness, and rights authorities pass.
Freeze the GENCODE v49 TSS/gene derivation and quantify how the changed roster affects score denominators; keep upstream binary thresholds diagnostic only.
Freeze all fold-specific donor-state tracks, candidate peaks, transforms, gene filters, genomic blocks, contact settings, and output hashes.
Audit and hash any MegaMap or other contact artifact before use; otherwise retain the power-law lane only.
Keep any allele-specific activity and signed direction model separately named and frozen before sealed inference.
